system.description: At the start of each floor, choose a new Class from a random list of three provided by the GM. You gain a random assortment of the new Class's abilities for the remainder of the current floor, while keeping your current ones. For each bullet point line item in the new Class description, roll 1d2. On a 2, you gain the listed abilities.

upgrades.description: The random Classes increase in rarity and power based on the crawler's Stats and Level.
Skill Ranks gained in any newly-granted Skills persist from floor to floor, but the starting Ranks of those Skills are lost.
You choose the Class from any available.

system.limitations: Former Child Actor Class Only. Rank increases by 1 when descending to a new floor only.
